Unwrap ZwiftPower [value, flag] columns

Source: R/zwiftpower.R
zp_unflag.Rd

Many ZwiftPower numeric fields arrive as small arrays rather than scalars, which become list-columns in the returned tibble:

Usage

zp_unflag(tbl)

Arguments

tbl

A tibble returned by a zp_*() function.

Value

tbl with those list-columns replaced by atomic columns.

Details

  • [value, flag] pairs — results/profile fields such as avg_wkg, avg_power, time, weight, wkg1200;

  • [code, value, percentile] triples — the sign-up power bests (cp_300_wkg, cp_1200_watts, ...). Verified: element 2 is the value (cp_*_watts[2] / weight == cp_*_wkg[2]).

zp_unflag() replaces every such column with its value, converted to number where possible.

Examples

x <- tibble::tibble(zwid = 1:2,
                    avg_wkg = list(c("3.8", "0"), c("4.1", "0")),
                    cp_300_wkg = list(c("8", "3.7", "23.4"), c("8", "4.2", "51.0")))
zp_unflag(x)
#> # A tibble: 2 × 3
#>    zwid avg_wkg cp_300_wkg
#>   <int>   <dbl>      <dbl>
#> 1     1     3.8        3.7
#> 2     2     4.1        4.2
